notes.title: Major update is going live very soon!
notes.notes:
Edit: The build is now live!

Hello again everyone,
 
I'm going to make the new update live now. I've implemented Steam Inventory recently and instead of removing it, I've decided to bring it back.

So the plan is:
* Release the major update
* Bring back Steam Inventory
* Update the store page with the new game update

Also, some notes about the new update:
* Changed the gameplay completely, I've changed it to co-op so now the server only allows up to 4 players
* Added AI enemies
* Added custom server hosting, you can now host your own servers
* Added a few co-op missions
* Added in-game music
* Added Steam Inventory (it's currently removed, I'll work on it right now)
* Bunch of bug fixes and lots of various changes

Sorry for the lack of gameplay content so far, this mode is not finished yet, but I have to release something right now. I've been working alone for the past couple of months so I have to take care of lots of stuff by myself, so it's not very easy for me.

So now I'll work on doing these things. Let me know what you think!

-Augustas
